marcus.audio_profile: Marcus, 22, a big, easygoing young man with a deep voice, a night security guard and nursing student, suddenly seeing something scary in the parking garage and talking low into his walkie-talkie.

scene: Heard over a walkie-talkie in an empty parking garage at night.
sample_context: A radio call in a zombie story.

chunks.text: [low, tense] Danny. There's a guy on the ramp. He's walking... wrong.
